description: print:check type-checks the package source and its five registered suites with `tsc --noEmit` and bundles the source, so it reads the TypeScript program of exactly those six entry files (type-only imports and declaration companions included) resolved with the root tsconfig options, never the product tree or the dependency umbrellas `reads` and `^default` stand for; the command closure of the target script is added by the graph inference.
